intro: Dominica relies on farming, ecotourism and citizenship by investment.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Bananas, root crops and bay oil are produced. Hiking, diving and whale watching attract visitors. A large share of government income comes from selling citizenship.

chapters.title: Geothermal
text: Dominica is developing geothermal power from its volcanoes.

keyTerms.meaning: Oil from bay leaves used in perfumes.

cardGroups.title: Made in Dominica
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Dominica makes and sells to the world.
